summary: Pro tier deep decompilation, liquidity drain stress-testing, and privileged access audit for Synthetix SNX.

findings.title: Oracle Front-Running & Fee Reclamation Timing Gap
findings.description: Atomic exchanges between synths exposed to latency arbitrage between off-chain FX/spot markets and on-chain oracle updates.

attackSurface.category: Synthetic Debt Pool & Dynamic Fee Circuit
attackSurface.attackVector: Bot observes off-chain market jump, front-runs Chainlink update by swapping sUSD to sBTC, then exits immediately after price update.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
